{{Quote|As part of her efforts to lessen infighting and streamline decision-making, Empress Acina has consolidated the Dark Council down from twelve seats to five.|[[Lana Beniko]]|<ref name="SOTG" />}}
The '''Sphere of Military Command''' was one of the five [[Spheres of Influence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that was created by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] after the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. The Sphere was the combination of the Spheres of [[Sphere of Defense of the Empire|Defense of the Empire]], [[Sphere of Military Offense|Military Offense]], and [[Sphere of Military Strategy|Military Strategy]] and was led by [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Krovos]].<ref name="SOTG" />

==History==
The Sphere of Military Command was a power base of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] responsible for the defensive and offensive operations of the Empire. It was established by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] to lessen the infighting between [[Dark Council]] members, and was one of the five seats that succeeded the twelve [[Spheres of Influence]]. The Sphere was led by [[Darth Krovos]].
